title: Noen, noe, ingen, and ingenting
goal: Choose noen, noe, ingen, and ingenting in simple Bokmål sentences.

objectives.statement: Choose noen, noe, ingen, and ingenting in simple Bokmål sentences.

sections.title: A study evening with an empty cupboard

spans.value: Lina has invited several classmates to her flat for a study evening. Marius arrives early to help her prepare.
Kommer noen av de andre snart?

blocks.translation: Are any of the others coming soon?

spans.value: Nei, ingen kommer før klokka seks.

blocks.translation: No, no one is coming before six o’clock.

spans.value: Greit. Har vi noe å servere?

blocks.translation: All right. Do we have anything to serve?

spans.value: Vi har noen epler og noen kjeks.

blocks.translation: We have some apples and some biscuits.

spans.value: Fint. Har vi noe å drikke?

blocks.translation: Good. Do we have anything to drink?

spans.value: Det er ingen kaffe igjen, og vi har ikke noe te.

blocks.translation: There is no coffee left, and we don’t have any tea.

spans.value: Så vi har ingenting å drikke?

blocks.translation: So we have nothing to drink?

spans.value: Vi har vann. Men ingen vil ha bare vann på en fredagskveld!

blocks.translation: We have water. But no one wants only water on a Friday evening!

Now consider the negative side of the scene. Marius reports that no classmates will arrive before six and that there is no coffee or tea. Lina asks whether that means they have nothing to drink, and Marius corrects her by pointing out that they have water.

The doorbell rings. Sara has arrived earlier than expected.
Ja, vi er på kjøkkenet. Har du med noe å drikke?

blocks.translation: Yes, we’re in the kitchen. Did you bring anything to drink?

spans.value: Jeg har med noen flasker mineralvann.

blocks.translation: I brought some bottles of mineral water.

spans.value: Flott! Vi hadde ingenting bortsett fra vann fra springen.

blocks.translation: Great! We had nothing except tap water.
Is no one else coming early?

spans.value: Nei. Og vi har ingen rene glass.

blocks.translation: No. And we have no clean glasses.

spans.value: Det gjør ingenting. Vi kan vaske noen glass.

blocks.translation: That doesn’t matter. We can wash some glasses.

sections.title: Cumulative transfer: preparing for a train journey

spans.value: Now move away from Lina’s study evening. Jonas and Amalie are packing for an early train. They need to check whether anyone else is joining them, whether they have food, and whether anything is missing.

prompt.value: Complete each gap with noen or noe. Use the Norwegian noun or wider meaning as evidence, not a direct English translation.

explanation.value: Use «noen» for people and plural countable nouns, «noe» for an unspecified thing, amount, mass noun, or before an infinitive, «ingen» with people/countable nouns, and stand-alone «ingenting» for nothing.

prompt.value: Complete each consecutive sentence pair. Use the same Norwegian form in each pair even when English would use some in one sentence and any in the other.
The study group is about to arrive at an empty flat. Complete each sentence with the appropriate negative indefinite form. Use the referent, following noun, and infinitive pattern as evidence.

Complete the fixed message frames. In frames without ikke, use the required negative form; in frames with ikke, use noen or noe. Use the referent and following noun or infinitive. Do not choose between equivalent negative constructions.

spans.value: På det tomme bordet er det

prompt.value: Arrange all supplied tokens into one connected kitchen exchange. Use every token exactly once. The exchange must coordinate noen for people or plural countable items, noe for an amount and before an infinitive, ingen before a plural noun, and ingenting as a stand-alone absent thing. Do not use the expression Det gjør ingenting.

Classify every sentence into exactly one bucket. Each bucket label states the target form and the taught clue. Select the bucket that matches both the form and its referent pattern; the classification records the clue used.

buckets.label: Stand-alone person or plural countable item
Stand-alone unspecified thing, substance or amount, or before an infinitive
No person, or no singular or plural noun

items.text: Det står noen kopper på bordet.
Det er ingen stol ved døren.
Det er ingen lampe i gangen.
Det er ingen kopper på bordet.

prompt.value: Arrange all supplied tokens into a connected exchange in the new train context. Use every token exactly once. The exchange must use noen for passengers or plural countable items, noe for an amount and before an infinitive, ingen before a singular noun, and ingenting as a stand-alone form.

Without looking back, write four short, simple Bokmål sentences about a shop that has closed for the day. Use each of the four indefinite forms taught in this lesson once, and make every intended referent clear through the context. Keep the situation fresh and do not copy the kitchen dialogue.

payload.judge_prompt: Check the response against the task and report evidence for every criterion. Accept natural Bokmål variants when they preserve the requested form, clear referent, and meaning.

criteria.instruction: Writes four short, simple Bokmål sentences about the closed shop.
Uses noen in one sentence for a clear person or plural countable referent.
Uses noe in one sentence for a clear unspecified thing, substance or amount, or infinitive pattern.
Uses ingen in one sentence as stand-alone no one or before a singular en- or ei-noun or plural noun.
Uses ingenting as a stand-alone word meaning nothing.
